title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in Zimbabwe, implemented by partners CCJP, ZELA, ZPP, WLSA, aims to achieve more accountable relationships between communities and government authorities. The objectives of the grant are to support peace and protection, participation and sustainable use of land, and to support civil society to be more resilience so that they can continue to defend human rights and promote accountability, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. Objectives: Objective 3 - Partner Agency: Partner organisations have increased agency; they are stronger, can do more and can relate better Outcomes: Communities (and in particular women and marginalised groups) and government authorities have productive and more accountable relationships which are supporting greater peace and protection, participation and accountable and sustainable use of land. Civil society are more resilient to narrowing civic space and can continue their work in promoting human rights and accountability
